# James Wallace Education

> Specialist SEND and EOTAS teaching for children who cannot manage school. In person across the East Midlands, mainly Derby, Derbyshire, Nottingham and Nottinghamshire, and online. James Wallace: QTS, MEd, enhanced DBS on the Update Service. For families, agencies and local authorities.

James Wallace Education Ltd is registered in England and Wales, company number 17479328. Contact: hello@jameswallace.tech, 07897 021077. Enquiries are answered within 2 working days.

## Services

- [Private SEND and EOTAS tuition](https://jameswallace.tech/tuition): one-to-one tuition for children who cannot manage school, for parents and carers.
- [For local authorities](https://jameswallace.tech/for-las): how commissioning works, from referral to first session, weekly plans, daily reports and safeguarding nil returns.
- [For agencies and schools](https://jameswallace.tech/agencies): a compliance-ready specialist SEND tutor; compliance pack on request.
- [Provision](https://jameswallace.tech/provision): one-to-one and small-group provision for learners with autism, ADHD, PDA and anxiety-based school avoidance.
- [SEND tuition in Derbyshire](https://jameswallace.tech/send-tuition-derbyshire) and [in Nottinghamshire](https://jameswallace.tech/send-tuition-nottinghamshire): the council routes for families.
- [Contact](https://jameswallace.tech/contact)
